items.headline: Amazon deforestation in Brazil falls to its lowest level since records began
items.summary: Brazil's official satellite data shows forest clearing in the Amazon fell almost 42 percent in a year, to 3,335 square kilometers, the lowest figure since tracking began in 1988. Deforestation is down 71 percent since 2022, largely because of stronger enforcement.
items.why_it_matters: The Amazon is vital for the climate and biodiversity, and this shows that sustained policy can rapidly slow forest loss.

items.headline: Europe recommends approval of orforglipron, a once-daily weight-loss and diabetes pill
items.summary: Europe's medicines regulator recommended approving orforglipron, sold as Foundayo, a daily tablet in the same drug family as the popular weight-loss injections, for obesity and type 2 diabetes. In trials, adults lost about 5 to 11 percent of their body weight over 72 weeks, compared with about 2 percent on placebo.
items.why_it_matters: A pill that can be taken at any time of day, with or without food, could reach far more people than injectable versions.
